Listing pages — per-group comparison

Sections screenshotted from the live pages · desktop 1280px · captured 2026-08-07 · scores are expert heuristic judgments, see method note
Method. Feature rows record what each captured page shows or can do (✓ present · ~ weakened/partial · — absent · text where a value says more). Scores are a structured heuristic evaluation — Nielsen-style expert judgment on three criteria, 1–5: Findability (how surely a first-time visitor locates the answer), Interaction cost (clicks, inputs and scrolling to the actual answer; 5 = zero effort), Clarity & honesty (plain language, no dark patterns). They are NOT measured usability metrics — SUS, task-success and time-on-task need real participants; treat these as a calibrated expert pass that says where to look, not a lab result. Ebrostay is scored with the same rubric — where it wins, the rationale says why in checkable terms.
